name: Plainstrider Kidney
summary: Across the Barrens, hunters gather Plainstrider Kidney for Kalimdor’s unusual brewing traditions. Most travelers find the organ unappetizing, but it is essential to an exotic ale.

sections.title: An Unorthodox Brewing Ingredient
sections.body:
Tall, flightless plainstriders roam the Barrens, and hunters take their feathers and meat for tools and simple rations. Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet seeks their kidneys for a different purpose: he says they are needed to recreate Chen Stormstout’s legendary potent ale.

Drohn says the kidneys give the brew a unique kick. The recipe belongs to an unconventional line of brewmasters, passed down through the years.

faq.q: What is a Plainstrider Kidney used for?
aliases: why do i need plainstrider kidneys
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn in Ratchet needs plainstrider kidneys to recreate a legendary batch of Stormstout ale. He says his mentor learned the recipe from Chen Stormstout, the wandering pandaren Brewmaster.

faq.q: Why would someone brew ale with animal organs?
faq.answer: Kalimdor’s unusual brews often use parts from rugged local wildlife for strong flavors and a distinct kick. Brewmaster Drohn says making potent, wild recipes reminds him of unorthodox creations such as trogg brew.
Fleeting, ornery, and greater plainstriders that roam the Barrens yield these kidneys.

faq.q: What other ingredients are needed alongside the kidneys?
faq.answer: Brewmaster Drohn asks for five plainstrider kidneys, five savannah lion tusks, and one thunder lizard horn for his concoction.

angles.text: As a cook, you may balk at fermenting avian kidneys into fine spirits. In Kalimdor’s wilderness, survival often means making full use of every part of the kill.
As a hunter, you must dress plainstriders carefully across the savanna to keep their internal organs intact for trade with Ratchet’s brewmasters.
